learning_objectives: Understand key concepts of Water: A Precious Resource
Solve exercises and apply rules related to Water: A Precious Resource

base_story_template.en: Welcome {{STUDENT_NAME}} to our learning session at the {{INTEREST_PLACE}}! Today we explore Water: A Precious Resource. This lesson is key to mapping how inputs transform to outputs.

concept_explanation.en: In this chapter, we explore Water: A Precious Resource in detail. This topic is essential for Grade 7 academic standards. We study the core principles, terminology, and real-world relevance.
concept_explanation.hi: इस अध्योय में हम जल: एक बहुमूल्य संसाधन का विस्तार से अध्ययन करते हैं॥
concept_explanation.kn: ಈ ಅಧ್ಯಾಯದಲ್ಲಿ, ನಾವು ನೀರು: ಒಂದು ಅಮೂಲ್ಯ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲ ದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿವರವಾಗಿ ಕಲಿಯುತ್ಧೇವೆ.
